## 작업 1: build.gradle.kts 수정
파일: outbound-adapter/proxy/build.gradle.kts

현재 내용:
```kotlin
dependencies {
    implementation(project(":domain:proxy"))

    testImplementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-test")

    testImplementation("io.kotest:kotest-assertions-core-jvm")
```

`:outbound:client:proxy-api` 다음에 추가:

## 작업 2: ProxyCacheProperties.kt 생성
파일: outbound-adapter/proxy/src/main/kotlin/com/cowave/search/outbound_adapter/proxy/cache/ProxyCacheProperties.kt

```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy.cache

import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties

@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "proxy.cache")
data class ProxyCacheProperties(
    val l1: L1Config = L1Config(),
    val l2: L2Config = L2Config(),
    val entity: EntityConfig = EntityConfig(),
) {
    data class L1Config(
        val defaultTtlMinutes: Long = 30,
        val maxSize: Long = 10000,
    )

    data class L2Config(
        val defaultTtlMinutes: Long = 60,
    )

    data class EntityConfig(
        val category: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.category.cache"),
        val brand: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.brand.cache"),
        val manufacturer: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.manufacturer.cache"),
        val mall: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.mall.cache"),
    )

    data class EntityCacheConfig(
        val keyPrefix: String,
        val l1TtlMinutes: Long? = null,
        val l2TtlMinutes: Long? = null,
    )
}
```

## 작업 3: ProxyCacheConfig.kt 생성
파일: outbound-adapter/proxy/src/main/kotlin/com/cowave/search/outbound_adapter/proxy/cache/ProxyCacheConfig.kt

```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy.cache

import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.brand.Brand
import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.category.Category
import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.mall.Mall
import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.manufacturer.Manufacturer
import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered.CaffeineLocalCache
import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered.JacksonCacheSerializer
import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered.TieredCache
import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered.TieredCacheImpl
import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered.ValkeyRemoteCache
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.EnableConfigurationProperties
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate
import java.time.Duration

@Configuration
@EnableConfigurationProperties(ProxyCacheProperties::class)
class ProxyCacheConfig(
    private val properties: ProxyCacheProperties,
    private val redisTemplate: RedisTemplate<String, String>,
    private val objectMapper: ObjectMapper,
) {
    @Bean
    fun categoryTieredCache(): TieredCache<Int, Category> =
        buildCache(
            entityConfig = properties.entity.category,
            type = Category::class.java,
            idExtractor = { it.id },
        )

    @Bean
    fun brandTieredCache(): TieredCache<Long, Brand> =
        buildCache(
            entityConfig = properties.entity.brand,
            type = Brand::class.java,
            idExtractor = { it.id },
        )

    @Bean
    fun manufacturerTieredCache(): TieredCache<Long, Manufacturer> =
        buildCache(
            entityConfig = properties.entity.manufacturer,
            type = Manufacturer::class.java,
            idExtractor = { it.id },
        )

    @Bean
    fun mallTieredCache(): TieredCache<Int, Mall> =
        buildCache(
            entityConfig = properties.entity.mall,
            type = Mall::class.java,
            idExtractor = { it.mallId },
        )

    private fun <ID : Any, V : Any> buildCache(
        entityConfig: ProxyCacheProperties.EntityCacheConfig,
        type: Class<V>,
        idExtractor: (V) -> ID,
    ): TieredCache<ID, V> {
        val l1Ttl = Duration.ofMinutes(entityConfig.l1TtlMinutes ?: properties.l1.defaultTtlMinutes)
        val l2Ttl = Duration.ofMinutes(entityConfig.l2TtlMinutes ?: properties.l2.defaultTtlMinutes)

        val l1 = CaffeineLocalCache<ID, V>(ttl = l1Ttl, maxSize = properties.l1.maxSize)
        val serializer = JacksonCacheSerializer(objectMapper, type)
        val l2 = ValkeyRemoteCache<ID, V>(redisTemplate, serializer, entityConfig.keyPrefix, l2Ttl)

        return TieredCacheImpl(l1, l2, idExtractor)
    }
}
```

## 작업 5: 4개 Caching Decorator 생성

### CachingCategoryRepository.kt
파일: outbound-adapter/proxy/src/main/kotlin/com/cowave/search/outbound_adapter/proxy/cache/CachingCategoryRepository.kt

```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy.cache

import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.category.Category
import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.category.CategoryRepository
import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered.TieredCache
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Primary
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component

@Primary
@Component
class CachingCategoryRepository(
    @Qualifier("graphqlCategoryRepository") private val delegate: CategoryRepository,
    private val cache: TieredCache<Int, Category>,
) : CategoryRepository {
    override fun findAllByIds(categoryIds: List<Int>): List<Category> =
        cache.getOrFetch(categoryIds) { missingIds -> delegate.findAllByIds(missingIds) }
}
```

차이점을 발견했습니다. 수정이 필요한 부분:

1. **ProxyCacheConfig.kt** - 생성자 파라미터 순서 (`redisTemplate`과 `objectMapper` 순서), Bean 메서드 스타일 (expression body vs block body), `buildCache` 호출 시 named arguments 사용
2. **Caching Decorators 4개** - 생성자 파라미터 순서 (`delegate`가 먼저), lambda 파라미터 이름 (`ids` → `missingIds`)
3. **YAML** - 엔티티별 `l1-ttl-minutes`와 `l2-ttl-minutes` 누락, key-prefix에 따옴표 없음

수정하겠습니다.
